summary: English and Burmese first-party discovery identified Myanmar SLRD as the general national cadastral and land-record agency and official Maubin mapping/report references. No public Maubin parcel viewer/API or safe anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was qualified. SLRD direct requests met a Cloudflare challenge; no bypass or TLS exception was used. No sample was retained.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: All executed discovery queries, URLs, request outcomes, schema/CRS checks, safe field allowlist, scope limits, and uncertainty are recorded in city-5151-maubin.json. The official Maubin government notice loaded as contextual evidence but did not expose parcel data.

custodians.name: Settlement and Land Records Department (SLRD)
custodians.scope: General national land-record, survey, cadastral-map, and land-use agency; Maubin-specific local registry evidence was not found.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native cadastral parcel identifier only if source-proven
full parcel polygon geometry only when safely returned
scopeLimits: The exact WUP point, rank, city code, country, and population are preserved in the city record.
A zero exact-point hit, Cloudflare challenge, or unavailable public service is not evidence of citywide parcel absence.
No local Maubin registry/map endpoint, public parcel schema, CRS, native ID, or anonymous geometry response was qualified.
No unsafe fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion is not source integration/admission.
uncertainty: SLRD records may exist behind local offices or non-public systems.
Official Maubin references found were administrative/census or civic mapping references, not parcel vector services.
